title: Vertical timeline of milestones
when: The user wants a timeline of events, such as company history, a project roadmap or a career path.
inputs: the events with date, title and text
prompt:
Goal: An ordered list styled as a vertical line with dots, alternating on wide screens and single sided on phones.
Steps:
1. <ol class="timeline"> with one <li> per event: a <time datetime="2019-03">, an h3 title and one short paragraph.
2. Draw the line with ::before on the list (2 px wide) and the dots with ::before on each item.
3. From about 860 px alternate items left and right of a centered line using a three column grid; below it, line at the left, one column.
4. Roadmap status is a text badge (Done, In progress, Planned), not only a dot color.
5. An optional reveal on scroll uses opacity only and is off under prefers-reduced-motion.
Quality bar:
- Dates use one format.
- Each entry fits in about 40 words.
- The reading order matches the visual order on both layouts.
Pitfalls:
- A plain div list where order carries no meaning.
- Dates only in a decorative circle.
- Content hidden until animation, invisible without JS.
Verify:
- [ ] Events are in an ol with time elements.
- [ ] One column at 375 px.
- [ ] Status badges are text.
- [ ] Reduced motion shows everything at once.
Output: The timeline markup and timeline.css.

examples.input: linha do tempo da historia da empresa desde 2010
examples.output: ol of six events with time datetime, centered line alternating on desktop, left line on phones
